skills.name: Sawblade Tuning
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko's ATK to one enemy.

skills.name: Molten Detonation
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG equal to #2[i]% of Himeko's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

skills.name: Heavenly Flare
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko's ATK to all enemies. Himeko regenerates #2[i] extra Energy for each enemy defeated.

skills.name: Victory Rush
skills.desc:
When an enemy target is inflicted with Weakness Break, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge (max #2[i] points).
If Himeko is fully Charged when an ally target performs an attack, Himeko immediately performs 1 Follow-Up ATK and deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of her ATK to all enemies, consuming all Charge points.
At the start of the battle, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge.

skills.name: Incomplete Combustion
skills.desc: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for #4[i] second(s). After entering battle with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a #1[i]% base chance to increase Fire DMG taken by enemies by #2[i]% for #3[i] turn(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

passives.name: Starfire
passives.desc:
After using an attack, there is a 50% base chance to inflict Burn on enemies, lasting for 2 turn(s).
When afflicted with Burn, enemies take Fire DoT equal to 30% of Himeko's ATK at the start of each turn.

passives.name: Magma
passives.desc: Skill deals 20% more DMG to enemies currently afflicted with Burn.

passives.name: Benchmark
passives.desc: When current HP percentage is 80% or higher, CRIT Rate increases by 15%.
